blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Arabic-language stance detection remains challenging, and previous shared-task systems have largely relied on multitask learning and ensembles.
While these systems achieve state-of-the-art performance, their applicability and transferability are limited by the additional complexity introduced by multitask learning.
To reduce this complexity, we introduce CLASP-Ar , which reformulates the task as cloze-style masked language modeling.
In this approach, the target, predicted sentiment, and text are combined into a single prompt whose [MASK] prediction is restricted to a verbalizer-constrained label vocabulary.
When evaluated on the StanceEval-2026: Arabic Stance Detection Shared Task, our proposed approach achieves an F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} score of 71.36 % 71.36\% on Track 1 and 74.14 % 74.14\% on Track 2 test sets.
The code for CLASP-Ar is available at TTLab at StanceEval-2026
blocks.zh:
阿拉伯语定位检测仍然具有挑战性,之前的共享任务系统主要依靠多任务学习和综艺.
虽然这些系统实现了最先进的性能,但其适用性和可转移性却受到多任务学习带来的额外复杂性的限制。
为了减少这种复杂性,我们引入了CLASP-Ar,它将任务重新定型为cluze风格的蒙面语言模型.
在这种方法中,目标,预言情绪,和文本被组合成一个单一的提示,其[MASK]的预测被限制在一个语言化的-约束的标签词汇中.
当在 StanceEval-2026 上被评价: 阿拉伯 Stance 检测共享 任务,我们提议的方法实现Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}}在1号轨道的71.36% 71.36\%在71.34% 74.14\%在2号轨道的测试集.
CLASP-Ar的代码在StanceEval-2026的TTLab提供

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Social media platforms have become integral to daily life, facilitating real-time global connectivity and rapid communication, particularly during emergencies Muniz-Rodriguez et al. (2020) ; Ghosh et al. (2018) .
While these platforms have broadened participation in public discourse, the rapid growth in user engagement has also accelerated the spread of misinformation, contributing to adverse societal consequences such as increased polarization Van Bavel et al. (2021) ; Kubin and Von Sikorski (2021) .
As a result, there is a critical and growing need for automated tools capable of effectively analyzing social media content.
blocks.zh:
社交媒体平台已成为日常生活的组成部分,促进实时全球连通和快速通信,特别是在Muniz-Rodriguez等人(2020年);Ghosh等人(2018年)紧急情况期间。
虽然这些平台扩大了对公共言论的参与,但用户参与的迅速增长也加速了错误信息的传播,助长了负面的社会后果,例如范巴维尔等人(2021年);库宾和冯西科尔斯基(2021年)。
因此,对能够有效分析社交媒体内容的自动化工具的需求越来越迫切。

blocks.en:
One computational approach to examining online discourse is stance detection, which aims to infer a user’s stance toward a specific topic from their textual posts.
Typically formulated as a pairwise classification task in which a target topic and its corresponding text are jointly processed, stance detection has attracted considerable research interest Bar-Haim et al. (2017) ; Wei et al. (2016) ; Lynn et al. (2019) .
However, most of these efforts have focused primarily on English Zhang et al. (2024) .
To address this disparity in Arabic, Alturayeif et al. (2024) introduced the Arabic Stance Detection Shared Task in 2024, using the Mawqif dataset Alturayeif et al. (2022) to benchmark models on posts from X, formerly Twitter, across three distinct topics.
StanceEval 2026 Albalawi et al. (2026a) builds on this foundation by introducing an extended version of the Mawqif dataset. In the previous edition of the task, simple encoder-based architectures achieved highly competitive performance Badran et al. (2024) ; Hasanaath and Alansari (2024) .
blocks.zh:
分析在线言论的一个计算方法是定位检测,
通常将定位探测作为双向分类任务,对目标专题及其相应文本进行联合处理,引起了Bar-Haim等人(2017年)的研究兴趣;Wei等人(2016年);Lynn等人(2019年)。
然而,这些努力大多主要集中于英国的张等(2024年).
为了解决阿拉伯语中的这一差异,Alturayeif等人(2024年)在2024年推出了阿拉伯语Stance检测共享任务,使用Mawqif数据集Alturayeif等人(2022年),将来自X(原为Twitter)的帖子模型作为三个不同主题的基准.
StanceEval 2026 Albalawi et al. (2026a)通过引入Mawqif数据集的扩展版,在此基础上更进一步. 在上一期任务中,简单的编码器基础架构实现了高度竞争的性能Badran等人(2024年);Hasanaath和Alansari(2024年).

blocks.en:
Building on the success of these encoder architectures, we propose a strategy that leverages masked language modeling (MLM) and the bidirectional contextual representations of encoders while incorporating textual sentiment as an explicit feature.
More specifically, we propose CLASP-Ar , an MLM-based approach that combines principles from pattern-exploiting training (PET) and constrained decoding. It restricts the prediction vocabulary for the masked token to the discrete label space of the stance detection task.
The constrained generation strategy of CLASP-Ar yields substantial performance improvements over baseline models, achieving an average gain of approximately 2 F 1 F_{1} points across all stance labels.
blocks.zh:
基于这些编码器架构的成功,我们提出了一个战略,利用蒙面语言模型(MLM)和编码器的双向背景表述,同时将文字情感作为一个明确特征。
更具体地说,我们提出CLASP-Ar,一种基于MLM的方法,将模式探索培训的原则和受限制的解码结合起来。 它将蒙面符号的预测词汇限制在姿态检测任务的离散标签空间.
CLASP-ART的有限生成战略比基线模型大大提高了业绩,在所有标签上的平均收益约为2 F 1 F_{1}点。

blocks.en: The present study is organized into the following sections. First, Section 2 reviews the theoretical background and describes the task at hand along with the dataset. Section 3 then presents the underlying methodology and system architecture. The experimental setup and implementation details are covered in Section 4 . Next, Section 3 delivers an in-depth quantitative assessment of the system, further validated via ablation experiments. Lastly, Section 6 summarizes the central contributions to bring the paper to a close.
blocks.zh: 本研究报告分为以下几节。 首先,第2节审查理论背景,并介绍手头的任务和数据集。 然后,第3节介绍基本方法和系统架构。 试验设置和执行细节载于第4节。 其次,第3节对该系统进行了深入的定量评估,并通过衰减实验进一步验证。 最后,第6节总结了为完成该文件所作的中心贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Target-specific stance detection has been a prominent research area for over a decade.
Early foundational efforts include the SemEval-2016 shared task for English tweets Mohammad et al. (2016) and a subsequent shared task focusing on Chinese microblogs Xu et al. (2016) .
Since then, the field has expanded significantly, yielding datasets across diverse languages including Turkish, Czech, Italian, and Arabic Zhang et al. (2024) .
Following the same line, Albalawi et al. (2026a) introduced StanceEval 2026, a shared task for stance detection in Arabic.
blocks.zh:
10多年来,针对特定目标的立场探测一直是突出的研究领域。
早期的基础性努力包括SemEval-2016为英语推文Mohammad等人共同承担的任务(2016年),以及随后的一项以中国微博徐等人为主的共同任务(2016年).
此后,这个领域大幅扩展,产生了包括土耳其语,捷克语,意大利语,阿拉伯语张等多种语言的数据集(2024).
同线之后,Albalawi等人(2026a)推出了StanceEval 2026,这是阿拉伯语定位检测的一项共同任务.

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en:
This shared task uses Mawqif-XT Albalawi et al. (2026b) , an extended version of Mawqif Alturayeif et al. (2022) .
It is annotated with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm.
Each instance in this dataset consists of a target topic under debate and a corresponding controversial text.
The controversial text can express support ( favor ) for the target topic, opposition ( against ) to it, or a non-committal ( none ) stance.
blocks.zh:
这个共享的任务使用Mawqif-XT Albalawi等人(2026b),这是Mawqif Alturayeif等人(2022)的扩展版本.
它以立场、感情和讽刺来形容。
本数据集中的每一个实例都包含一个正在辩论的目标议题和相应的有争议的文本.
有争议的文本可以表达(赞成)对目标主题的支持,反对(反对),或者非承诺(无)立场.

blocks.en: 2.2 Tracks
blocks.zh: 2.2 轨迹

blocks.en:
This shared task consists of two tracks.
Track 1 evaluates models on targets observed during training whereas Track 2 evaluates models on unseen targets.
To handle unseen targets under Track 2 and build a robust system for stance detection, we use another dataset.
The second dataset is ArabicStance-X Alkhathlan et al. (2025) , which contains 14,477 tweets spanning 17 different topics, including economy , education , health , and religion .
Structurally, each major topic is divided into subcategories, which contain lists of controversial texts and their corresponding stance labels. The full details of this dataset along with the shared task dataset are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
这一共同的任务包括两个轨道。
第1轨评价培训期间观察到的目标模型,而第2轨评价未见目标模型。
为了处理第2轨下的隐形目标,并建立一个强大的姿态探测系统,我们使用另一个数据集.
包括经济、教育、卫生、宗教等17个不同议题。
从结构上来说,每个主要话题被分为子类,这些子类包含有争议的文本列表及其相应的姿态标签. 该数据集的全部细节以及共享的任务数据集见表1。

blocks.en:
The previous edition of Arabic Stance Detection Shared Task in 2024 Alturayeif et al. (2024) saw systems utilizing multi-task learning to build robust system.
The winning system, AlexUNLP-BH Badran et al. (2024) , used multi-task learning over sentiment and sarcasm, weighted cross-entropy with data augmentation, and an ensemble of models trained with different contrastive loss functions.
The strongest competitors adopted similarly resource-intensive strategies: the MGKM system Alghaslan and Almutairy (2024) was based on fine-tuned large language models such as GPT-3.5-Turbo , whereas StanceCrafters Hasanaath and Alansari (2024) combined two BERT -based encoders via an attention mechanism in a multitask setup.
These results suggest that auxiliary signals such as sentiment are highly informative for Arabic stance detection.
However, top-performing systems obtain these gains at the cost of target-specific models, multiple task heads, or ensembling.
In contrast, our approach incorporates sentiment as a simple input feature in a single cloze-style prompt and replaces the standard classification head with a verbalizer-constrained MLM objective, thereby retaining a single model across all targets and labels.
As a result, our approach largely avoids the complexity introduced by multitask learning and ensembling, making it more suitable for transfer across application scenarios.
blocks.zh:
前一期于2024年出版的阿拉伯语Stance检测共享任务(2024年)看到系统利用多任务学习来构建强大的系统.
获奖系统 AlexUNLP-BH Badran 等人(2024年)使用多任务学习,超越情绪和讽刺,加权交叉交替,数据增强,以及训练有不同对比性损失功能的模型组合.
最强大的竞争者采用了类似的资源密集型战略:MGKM系统Alghaslan和Almutairy(2024年)是基于GPT-3.5-Turbo等经过微调的大语言模型,而StanceCrafters Hasanaath和Alansari(2024年)通过多任务设置中的注意机制将两个基于BERT的编码器合并起来。
这些结果显示,情绪等辅助信号对阿拉伯定位检测信息非常丰富.
然而,顶级业绩的系统以牺牲特定目标模型、多重任务负责人或综艺为代价获得这些收益。
与此相反,我们的方法将情绪作为一个简单的输入特征纳入一个单块式的即时器,并将标准分类头替换为语言化的受约束的MLM目标,从而在所有目标和标签上保留一个单一的模型。
因此,我们的方法在很大程度上避免了多任务学习和综艺所带来的复杂性,使其更适合跨应用情景的转让.

CLASP-Ar ’s stance detection methodology draws on prompt-based learning paradigms, particularly pattern-exploiting training (PET) Schick and Schütze (2021) , and constrained decoding techniques Willard and Louf (2023) . Specifically, we reformulate the standard sequence classification objective as a cloze-style masked language modeling (MLM) task.
Given a target t t , a contextual sentiment label s s , and an input text x x , we construct a prompt sequence x prompt x_{\text{prompt}} containing a single [MASK] token: x prompt \displaystyle x_{\text{prompt}} = Target: t Sentiment: s \displaystyle=\text{Target: }t\text{ Sentiment: }s Stance: [MASK] Text: x \displaystyle\text{Stance: {[MASK]} Text: }x

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
To mitigate the class imbalance resulting from the scarcity of the None label, we adopt two strategies.
First, we optimize our model using a class-weighted cross-entropy loss function to ensure a balanced penalty distribution during training.
Secondly, we expand the Mawqif-XT dataset.
Specifically, we generate 1,815 additional None instances by randomly pairing controversial texts with mismatched, unrelated targets.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻 " 无 " 标签稀缺所造成的阶级不平衡,我们采取了两项战略。
一,优化模式 运用班级加权跨场损耗功能,确保培训期间罚分均衡.
第二,我们扩充Mawqif-XT数据集.
具体地说,我们再产生1 815个 没有通过随机将有争议的文本与不匹配,无关的目标对齐的例子.

blocks.en:
For our base architecture, we utilize the aubmindlab/bert-base-arabertv02-twitter encoder Antoun et al. (2020) based on the experiments shown in Appendix A .
To enhance the model’s domain adaptation and task-specific comprehension, we employ a two-stage training paradigm: • Phase 1: intermediate pre-training: The model is initially trained on the ArabicStance-X dataset Alkhathlan et al. (2025) for two epochs.
Because this auxiliary dataset natively lacks sentiment annotations, we apply SARF Abusaleh et al. (2026) , a dedicated Arabic sentiment analysis model, to generate the requisite sentiment values. • Phase 2: fine-tuning: Subsequently, the encoder is fine-tuned on our augmented Mawqif-XT dataset for up to 20 epochs.
To prevent overfitting, we apply early stopping with a patience of five epochs. Across both training phases, we maintain a consistent hyperparameter configuration: a maximum sequence length of 512 tokens, a learning rate of 2e-5, and a batch size of 32.
We evaluate model performance using overall classification accuracy and class-specific F1-scores for the favor , against , and none categories.
For our aggregate metrics, we use F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} (the macro-average of the two polar classes) as the primary measure, alongside F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} to account for all three classes.
blocks.zh:
根据附录A所示的实验,
为了提高该模式的域内适应和对具体任务的理解,我们采用了两阶段培训模式:第一阶段:中级预培训: 该模型最初在阿拉伯语Stance-X数据集Alkhathlan等人(2025年)上接受了两个纪元的培训.
由于这个辅助数据集在本土上缺乏情绪说明,我们应用了SARF Abusaleh等人(2026年)这个专用的阿拉伯语情绪分析模型来生成必要的情绪值. • 支助 第二阶段:微调: 之后,编码器被微调到我们扩充的Mawqif-XT数据集上,最多20个纪元.
为了防止过度适应,我们以五个时代的耐心及早停止。 在两个训练阶段,我们都保持一贯的超参数配置:最大序列长度为512令牌,学习速度为2e-5,批量大小为32.
我们利用总体分类精度和特定等级的F1分数来评价模型性能。
对于我们的总度量,我们使用Favg2 F_{\Q_{\text{avg2}}} (两个极地类的宏观平均值)作为主要衡量标准,与Favg3 F_{\text{avg3}一起计算所有三个类.

Phase 1: intermediate pre-training: The model is initially trained on the ArabicStance-X dataset Alkhathlan et al. (2025) for two epochs.
Because this auxiliary dataset natively lacks sentiment annotations, we apply SARF Abusaleh et al. (2026) , a dedicated Arabic sentiment analysis model, to generate the requisite sentiment values.

第一阶段:中期预训: 该模型最初在阿拉伯语Stance-X数据集Alkhathlan等人(2025年)上接受了两个纪元的培训.
由于这个辅助数据集在本土上缺乏情绪说明,我们应用了SARF Abusaleh等人(2026年)这个专用的阿拉伯语情绪分析模型来生成必要的情绪值.

Phase 2: fine-tuning: Subsequently, the encoder is fine-tuned on our augmented Mawqif-XT dataset for up to 20 epochs.
To prevent overfitting, we apply early stopping with a patience of five epochs.

第二阶段:微调: 之后,编码器被微调到我们扩充的Mawqif-XT数据集上,最多20个纪元.
为了防止过度适应,我们以五个时代的耐心及早停止。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Table 2 presents the official evaluation results across both tracks.
Overall, CLASP-Ar demonstrates superior performance on Track 2 (unseen targets), achieving an F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} of 74.14 % 74.14\% and an F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} of 65.64 % 65.64\% .
Conversely, on Track 1 (seen targets), the model yields an F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} of 71.36 % 71.36\% but experiences a notable drop in F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} ( 53.13 % 53.13\% ).
The substantially lower F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} indicates that CLASP-Ar struggles to reliably predict the None class for this unobserved target.
Overall, we attribute CLASP-Ar ’s strong generalization to Track 2’s unseen targets primarily to the pre-training stage, where exposure to a diverse array of target domains enhanced zero-shot target adaptability.

表2列出了两个轨道的官方评价结果。
总体而言,CLASP-Ar在第2轨(未见目标)上表现优异,实现了Favg2 F_{\vg2}}74.14% 74.14\%和Favg3 F_{\vg3}}65.64% 65.64\%.
相反,在第1轨(见目标)上,该模型的产值为71.36%的Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}},但Favg3 F_{\text{avg3}}(53.13% 53.13\%)出现显著下降。
Favg3 FQQQText{avg3}}}的大幅下降表明,CLASP-Ar试图可靠地预测这个无人观察的目标的None类.
总体来说,我们把CLASP-Ar的强烈概括性归功于第2轨的未见目标,这主要归功于培训前阶段,在培训前阶段,接触各种各样的目标领域可增强零射目标适应性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Impact of Class Imbalance Mitigation Strategies
blocks.zh: 5.1 缓解不平衡战略的影响

blocks.en:
To systematically evaluate the impact of our class-imbalance mitigation strategies, we conducted multi-seed experiments on the training and development sets.
Notably, the inclusion of augmented None instances (Extended None in Table 3 ) mostly improved performance on the Against label, while consistently harming performance on the None label.
This could mean the augmentation strategy helped create a much clearer boundary between the Against and None labels.
On the other hand, using class-weighted cross-entropy significantly improved model performance on the None label, evident from the large gains in F none F_{\text{none}} ( ∼ \sim +7%) and F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} ( ∼ \sim +2%) over the baseline.
Overall, both approaches boosted performance compared with the baseline and the base configuration, underscoring the effectiveness of these techniques.
blocks.zh:
为了系统地评估我们班级平衡减缓战略的影响,我们对培训和开发成套软件进行了多种子试验。
值得注意的是,在 " 反标签 " 上增加 " 无 " 实例(表3中的无 " 无 " 实例),主要是改进了业绩,同时始终损害 " 无 " 标签上的绩效。
这可能意味着扩大战略有助于在 " 反对 " 和 " 无 " 标签之间建立更明确的界限。
另一方面,在None 标签上,使用类加权交叉切换方式大大改进了模型性能,这从Fno Fno FnoText{none}中的巨大收益可见一斑. (\\sim + 7%)和 Favg3 F_{\text{avg3}(\sim + 2%) 超过基线 。
总体而言,这两种方法都与基线和基础配置相比提高了绩效,突出了这些技术的有效性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Impact of Auxilliary Sentiment and Sarcasm Information
blocks.zh: 5.2 辅助感知和讽刺信息的影响

blocks.en:
To evaluate the contribution of auxiliary task signals present in the dataset, we conduct an ablation study across three random seeds by incrementally integrating sentiment and sarcasm features.
As shown in Table 4 , incorporating sentiment information yields the most pronounced performance boost, increasing F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} by 1.38 points over the baseline ( 86.28 % 86.28\% vs. 84.90 % 84.90\% ) and achieving the highest overall accuracy ( 84.38 % 84.38\% ).
While incorporating both auxiliary features yields the highest F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} ( 72.50 % 72.50\% ), sentiment alone provides the strongest consistent gain across metrics, validating its integration into CLASP-Ar .
Detailed class- and target-specific ablation results are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
为了评价数据集中存在的辅助任务信号的贡献,我们通过渐进结合情绪和讽刺特征,对三个随机种子进行减速研究.
如表4所示,纳入情绪信息能产生最显著的性能提升,使Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}比基准增加1.38点(86.28% 86.28\%对84.90% 84.90\%),实现最高整体准确度(84.38% 84.38\%)。
虽然将两个辅助特性结合起来可以产生最高的Favg3 F_{\vg{vg3}(72.50% 72.50\%),但单是情感就能提供最强的一致收益,从而证明它融入了CLASP-Ar.

blocks.en: 5.3 Sentiment Source
blocks.zh: 5.3 感官来源

blocks.en:
Since ArabicStance-X nor the official task test data contains no sentiment annotations for data, we generate them with an external Arabic sentiment classifier.
We compare two sources: a frozen off-the-shelf sentiment-tuned XLM-RoBERTa based model Barbieri et al. (2022) , and SARF Abusaleh et al. (2026) , a multi-view Arabic sentiment analyzer that fuses surface, stemmed, and rooted morphological representations from a shared MARBERTv2 encoder via a hybrid CNN–BiLSTM–attention head. SARF improves the dev F avg2 F_{\mathrm{avg2}} from 80.96 % 80.96\% to 81.50 % 81.50\% , so we adopt it as the sentiment source.

由于ArabStance-X或官方任务测试数据没有包含数据情感说明,我们用外部阿拉伯语情感分类器生成数据.
我们比较了两个来源:一个冷冻的现成情绪调谐XLM-ROBERTA基于Babieri等人的模型(2022年),以及SARF Abusaleh等人(2026年),一个多视角的阿拉伯情绪分析器,通过混合的CNN-BILSTM注意头,将一个共享的MARBERTv2编码器的形态表达法融为一体。 SARF改进了dev F avg2 F_{\ mathrm{avg2}},从80.96% 80.96\%提高到81.50% 81.50\%,所以我们把它作为情绪来源.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present CLASP-Ar , a cloze-style masked language modeling framework tailored for stance detection.
Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that incorporating auxiliary task signals, particularly sentiment features, substantially enhances model performance, improving F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} by up to 1.38 points.
Furthermore, our targeted class-imbalance mitigation strategies, such as class weighting, effectively boost performance on the underrepresented None class by up to 9 F 1 F_{1} points.
Evaluated on the official StanceEval-2026 benchmark, CLASP-Ar achieves strong generalization on unseen targets, securing F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} scores of 71.36 % 71.36\% on Track 1 and 74.14 % 74.14\% on Track 2.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了CLASP-Ar,这是一个适合定位检测的凝胶式遮盖语言模型框架。
通过广泛的实验,我们证明,纳入辅助任务信号,特别是情绪特征,可以大大增强模型性能,将Favg2 F_{\vgtext{avg2}}}提高1.38分。
此外,我们有针对性的班级平衡缓解战略,如班级加权,有效地提高了代表不足的无班级的成绩,最高达9分F 1 F_{1 }1 }。
根据官方的StanceEval-2026基准评估,CLASP-Ar在隐形目标上实现了强烈的概括,确保了Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}}在1号轨道上的71.36%的71.36%的成绩和2号轨道上的74.14%的74.14\%的成绩.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
While CLASP-Ar avoids the architectural overhead of multitask and ensemble architectures, it exhibits several limitations.
First, performance on the minority None class is notably low and highly volatile, with the standard deviation for F none F_{\text{none}} exceeding 10 points in certain configurations.
Second, augmenting None instances by pairing texts with unrelated targets represents a naive heuristic that may fail to capture genuine non-committal stances, potentially degrading precision boundaries for the Against class.
blocks.zh:
虽然CLASP-Ar避免了多任务和综艺建筑的建筑管理费,但它表现出了几种局限性.
第一,少数民族的表现 没有一类明显低且极不稳定,Fnone FQQText{无}的标准偏差在某些配置中超过10分.
第二,通过将文本与不相关的目标配对来增加“无”的例子,是一种天真的热情,可能无法抓住真正的非承诺立场,有可能降低“反阶级”的精确界限。

blocks.en: B.1 Data Augmentation vs. Loss Weighting
blocks.zh: B.1 数据增强与损失

blocks.en:
A comparison of data-level (Extended None) and loss-level (Class Weights) approaches shows a clear trade-off between detecting polar stances ( F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} ) and overall multi-class performance ( F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} ).
As we can see from Table 6 , Class Weights consistently improves the minority none class, delivering the highest F none F_{\text{none}} (52.83% with pre-training) with low cross-seed variance.
In contrast, data augmentation (Extended None) reduces F none F_{\text{none}} (falling to 38.55% without pre-training) and leads to pronounced instability ( σ = 10.81 \sigma=10.81 ).
This indicates that the augmented none instances inject feature noise, complicating convergence within the minority class space.
blocks.zh:
对数据级别(Extended None)和损失级别(Class Weights)方法的比较表明,在检测极地姿势(Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}})和整体多级性能(Favg3 F_{\text{avg3}})之间,有明显的权衡.
从表6可以看出,阶级重量持续改善少数无等级,提供最高的Fnone FQQText{none}}(52.83%有预训),跨种子差异较小.
与此相对照,数据增强(Extensed None)减少了Fno FQQText{none}(在未经预训的情况下降至38.55%),并导致明显不稳定(=10.81\sigma=10.81)。
这表明,任何增加的情况都没有引起噪音,使少数群体阶层空间内的趋同复杂化。

blocks.en:
However, Extended None effectively isolates the polar stance classes.
By artificially saturating the none distribution during training, the model establishes a stricter decision boundary for the favor and against categories, yielding the highest F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} (86.33% without pre-training).
Class weighting demonstrates the inverse effect, trading fractional F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} reductions for global macro-average ( F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} ) improvements.
blocks.zh:
然而,“无延伸”实际上孤立了两极立场类别。
该模式通过人工饱和培训期间的零分配,为优惠和对照类别确定了更严格的决定界限,产生了最高的Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}}(86.33%没有预培训)。
类权重显示反向效应,交易分数Favg2 FQQQText{avg2}用于全球宏平均值(Favg3 FQQQText{avg3})改进.

blocks.en:
At the target level ( Table 7 ), strategy efficacy strongly correlates with the underlying class distributions.
Extended None optimally resolves the Covid Vaccine target, which features a balanced polar distribution ( ∼ \sim 43% favor and against ), maximizing both F avg2 F_{\text{avg2}} (84.23%) and F avg3 F_{\text{avg3}} (69.44%) when pre-trained.
Conversely, for heavily skewed targets where the none class is an extreme minority (e.g., ∼ \sim 5% in Women Empowerment and ∼ \sim 10% in Digital Transformation ), Class Weights substantially outperforms augmentation by preventing minority class collapse.
Ultimately, class weighting is the superior mechanism for highly imbalanced distributions to maximize global macro-performance, whereas data augmentation is primarily advantageous for isolating stances in targets with balanced polar classes.
blocks.zh:
在目标一级(表7),战略效力与基本类别分布密切相关。
扩展无能最能解决Covid疫苗目标,该目标具有均衡的极性分布(\\sim 43%的偏好和反对),在预训时既能实现Favg2 F_{\text{avg2}}(84.23%),又能实现Favg3 F_{\text{avg3}}(69.44%)的最大化.
反之,对于高度扭曲的目标,即无阶级是极少数(例如,在赋予妇女权力方面为5%,在数字转型方面为10%),阶级重量通过防止少数阶级崩溃而大大超过增长。
归根结底,阶级权重是高度失衡的分布的优越机制,可以最大限度地提高全球宏观性能,而数据扩增主要有利于在具有均衡极性类别的目标中孤立立场。
